import HartshorneLib.Chapter4RegularDifferentialSheaf
import HartshorneLib.Chapter4GenericDifferentialLattice

/-!
# The regular differential sheaf as a scheme module

Regular rational differentials are stable under multiplication by regular
functions.  This file packages that intrinsic action as an `O_X`-module.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite TopologicalSpace
open AlgebraicGeometry

namespace Hartshorne

noncomputable section

attribute [local instance] functionFieldOverAlgebra stalkOverAlgebra
  stalkFunctionFieldOver_isScalarTower

variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
variable {X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))} [IsIntegral X.left]

open Classical in
noncomputable def regularDifferentialSectionAction (U : X.left.Opens)
    (r : Γ(X.left, U)) (s : regularDifferentialSections X U) :
    regularDifferentialSections X U :=
  if hU : (U : Set X.left).Nonempty then
    letI : Nonempty U := by simpa using hU
    ⟨(X.left.germToFunctionField U).hom r • (s : CurveRationalDifferentials X), by
      rw [mem_regularDifferentialSections_of_nonempty X hU]
      intro x hx hxU
      rw [germ_generic_eq_algebraMap_germ (genericPoint_mem_of_nonempty hU) hxU r,
        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul X.left.functionField]
      exact (curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x).smul_mem
        ((X.left.presheaf.germ U x hxU).hom r)
        ((mem_regularDifferentialSections_of_nonempty X hU).mp s.property x hx hxU)⟩
  else 0

lemma regularDifferentialSectionAction_coe_of_nonempty
    (U : X.left.Opens) (hU : (U : Set X.left).Nonempty)
    (r : Γ(X.left, U)) (s : regularDifferentialSections X U) :
    ((regularDifferentialSectionAction U r s : regularDifferentialSections X U) :
        CurveRationalDifferentials X) =
      letI : Nonempty U := by simpa using hU
      (X.left.germToFunctionField U).hom r • (s : CurveRationalDifferentials X) := by
  letI : Nonempty U := by simpa using hU
  rw [regularDifferentialSectionAction, dif_pos hU]

lemma regularDifferentialSectionAction_of_empty
    (U : X.left.Opens) (hU : ¬ (U : Set X.left).Nonempty)
    (r : Γ(X.left, U)) (s : regularDifferentialSections X U) :
    regularDifferentialSectionAction U r s = 0 := by
  classical
  rw [regularDifferentialSectionAction, dif_neg hU]

open Classical in
@[reducible] noncomputable def regularDifferentialSectionsModule
    (U : X.left.Opens) :
    Module Γ(X.left, U) (regularDifferentialSections X U) where
  smul := regularDifferentialSectionAction U
  one_smul s := by
    change regularDifferentialSectionAction U 1 s = s
    by_cases hU : (U : Set X.left).Nonempty
    · apply Subtype.ext
      letI : Nonempty U := by simpa using hU
      rw [regularDifferentialSectionAction_coe_of_nonempty U hU, map_one, one_smul]
    · letI := regularDifferentialSections_subsingleton_of_empty X hU
      exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
  mul_smul r t s := by
    change regularDifferentialSectionAction U (r * t) s =
      regularDifferentialSectionAction U r (regularDifferentialSectionAction U t s)
    by_cases hU : (U : Set X.left).Nonempty
    · apply Subtype.ext
      letI : Nonempty U := by simpa using hU
      rw [regularDifferentialSectionAction_coe_of_nonempty U hU,
        regularDifferentialSectionAction_coe_of_nonempty U hU,
        regularDifferentialSectionAction_coe_of_nonempty U hU, map_mul, mul_smul]
    · letI := regularDifferentialSections_subsingleton_of_empty X hU
      exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
  smul_zero r := by
    change regularDifferentialSectionAction U r 0 = 0
    by_cases hU : (U : Set X.left).Nonempty
    · apply Subtype.ext
      letI : Nonempty U := by simpa using hU
      rw [regularDifferentialSectionAction_coe_of_nonempty U hU]
      exact smul_zero _
    · exact regularDifferentialSectionAction_of_empty U hU r 0
  smul_add r s t := by
    change regularDifferentialSectionAction U r (s + t) =
      regularDifferentialSectionAction U r s + regularDifferentialSectionAction U r t
    by_cases hU : (U : Set X.left).Nonempty
    · apply Subtype.ext
      letI : Nonempty U := by simpa using hU
      rw [regularDifferentialSectionAction_coe_of_nonempty U hU]
      calc
        _ = (X.left.germToFunctionField U).hom r • (s : CurveRationalDifferentials X) +
              (X.left.germToFunctionField U).hom r • (t : CurveRationalDifferentials X) :=
          smul_add _ _ _
        _ = ((regularDifferentialSectionAction U r s :
                regularDifferentialSections X U) : CurveRationalDifferentials X) +
              ((regularDifferentialSectionAction U r t :
                regularDifferentialSections X U) : CurveRationalDifferentials X) := by
          rw [regularDifferentialSectionAction_coe_of_nonempty U hU,
            regularDifferentialSectionAction_coe_of_nonempty U hU]
    · letI := regularDifferentialSections_subsingleton_of_empty X hU
      exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
  add_smul r t s := by
    change regularDifferentialSectionAction U (r + t) s =
      regularDifferentialSectionAction U r s + regularDifferentialSectionAction U t s
    by_cases hU : (U : Set X.left).Nonempty
    · apply Subtype.ext
      letI : Nonempty U := by simpa using hU
      rw [regularDifferentialSectionAction_coe_of_nonempty U hU, map_add]
      calc
        _ = (X.left.germToFunctionField U).hom r • (s : CurveRationalDifferentials X) +
              (X.left.germToFunctionField U).hom t • (s : CurveRationalDifferentials X) :=
          add_smul _ _ _
        _ = ((regularDifferentialSectionAction U r s :
                regularDifferentialSections X U) : CurveRationalDifferentials X) +
              ((regularDifferentialSectionAction U t s :
                regularDifferentialSections X U) : CurveRationalDifferentials X) := by
          rw [regularDifferentialSectionAction_coe_of_nonempty U hU,
            regularDifferentialSectionAction_coe_of_nonempty U hU]
    · letI := regularDifferentialSections_subsingleton_of_empty X hU
      exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
  zero_smul s := by
    change regularDifferentialSectionAction U 0 s = 0
    by_cases hU : (U : Set X.left).Nonempty
    · apply Subtype.ext
      letI : Nonempty U := by simpa using hU
      rw [regularDifferentialSectionAction_coe_of_nonempty U hU, map_zero, zero_smul]
      rfl
    · exact regularDifferentialSectionAction_of_empty U hU 0 s

lemma regularDifferentialSectionsRes_action {U V : (X.left.Opens)ᵒᵖ} (i : U ⟶ V)
    (r : Γ(X.left, U.unop)) (s : regularDifferentialSections X U.unop) :
    regularDifferentialSectionsRes X (leOfHom i.unop)
        (regularDifferentialSectionAction U.unop r s) =
      regularDifferentialSectionAction V.unop ((X.left.presheaf.map i).hom r)
        (regularDifferentialSectionsRes X (leOfHom i.unop) s) := by
  classical
  by_cases hV : (V.unop : Set X.left).Nonempty
  · have hU : (U.unop : Set X.left).Nonempty := hV.mono (leOfHom i.unop)
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [regularDifferentialSectionsRes_coe X (leOfHom i.unop) hV,
      regularDifferentialSectionAction_coe_of_nonempty U.unop hU,
      regularDifferentialSectionAction_coe_of_nonempty V.unop hV,
      regularDifferentialSectionsRes_coe X (leOfHom i.unop) hV]
    letI : Nonempty U.unop := by simpa using hU
    letI : Nonempty V.unop := by simpa using hV
    have hres := X.left.presheaf.germ_res_apply i.unop (genericPoint X.left)
      (genericPoint_mem_of_nonempty hV) r
    have hres' :
        (X.left.germToFunctionField V.unop).hom
            ((X.left.presheaf.map i).hom r) =
          (X.left.germToFunctionField U.unop).hom r := by
      simpa using hres
    rw [hres']
  · letI := regularDifferentialSections_subsingleton_of_empty X hV
    exact Subsingleton.elim _ _

noncomputable def regularDifferentialAbPresheaf :
    X.left.Opensᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u} where
  obj U := AddCommGrpCat.of (regularDifferentialSections X U.unop)
  map {U V} i := AddCommGrpCat.ofHom
    (regularDifferentialSectionsRes X (leOfHom i.unop)).toAddMonoidHom
  map_id U := by
    apply AddCommGrpCat.hom_ext
    simp only [AddCommGrpCat.hom_ofHom, AddCommGrpCat.hom_id,
      regularDifferentialSectionsRes_id X (leOfHom (𝟙 U).unop)]
    ext s
    rfl
  map_comp {U V W} i j := by
    apply AddCommGrpCat.hom_ext
    have hcomp : regularDifferentialSectionsRes X (leOfHom (i ≫ j).unop) =
        (regularDifferentialSectionsRes X (leOfHom j.unop)).comp
          (regularDifferentialSectionsRes X (leOfHom i.unop)) :=
      regularDifferentialSectionsRes_comp X (leOfHom j.unop) (leOfHom i.unop)
    simp only [AddCommGrpCat.hom_ofHom, AddCommGrpCat.hom_comp, hcomp]
    ext s
    rfl

noncomputable def regularDifferentialPresheafOfModules : X.left.PresheafOfModules := by
  letI regularDifferentialModuleInstances :
      ∀ W, Module (X.left.ringCatSheaf.obj.obj W)
        ((regularDifferentialAbPresheaf (X := X)).obj W) :=
    fun W => regularDifferentialSectionsModule W.unop
  apply PresheafOfModules.ofPresheaf (regularDifferentialAbPresheaf (X := X))
  rintro ⟨U⟩ ⟨V⟩ i r s
  dsimp [regularDifferentialAbPresheaf]
  change regularDifferentialSectionsRes X (leOfHom i.unop)
      (regularDifferentialSectionAction U r s) =
    regularDifferentialSectionAction V ((X.left.presheaf.map i).hom r)
      (regularDifferentialSectionsRes X (leOfHom i.unop) s)
  exact regularDifferentialSectionsRes_action i r s

lemma regularDifferentialPresheafOfModules_presheaf :
    (regularDifferentialPresheafOfModules (X := X)).presheaf =
      regularDifferentialAbPresheaf (X := X) := by
  rw [regularDifferentialPresheafOfModules,
    PresheafOfModules.ofPresheaf_presheaf]

noncomputable def regularDifferentialAbPresheafIso :
    regularDifferentialAbPresheaf (X := X) ≅
      regularDifferentialPresheaf X ⋙ forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} k) AddCommGrpCat.{u} :=
  NatIso.ofComponents (fun _ => Iso.refl _) (fun _ => rfl)

variable [IsAlgClosed k] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom] [IsProper X.hom]

lemma isSheaf_regularDifferentialPresheafOfModules :
    Presheaf.IsSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology (X.left : TopCat))
      (regularDifferentialPresheafOfModules (X := X)).presheaf := by
  rw [regularDifferentialPresheafOfModules_presheaf,
    Presheaf.isSheaf_of_iso_iff (regularDifferentialAbPresheafIso (X := X))]
  exact Presheaf.isSheaf_comp_of_isSheaf
    (Opens.grothendieckTopology (X.left : TopCat))
    (regularDifferentialPresheaf X)
    (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} k) AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (isSheaf_regularDifferentialPresheaf X)

/-- The intrinsic regular differential sheaf as an actual `O_X`-module. -/
noncomputable def regularDifferentialModule : X.left.Modules where
  val := regularDifferentialPresheafOfModules (X := X)
  isSheaf := isSheaf_regularDifferentialPresheafOfModules (X := X)

lemma regularDifferentialModule_presheaf :
    (regularDifferentialModule (X := X)).presheaf = regularDifferentialAbPresheaf (X := X) :=
  regularDifferentialPresheafOfModules_presheaf (X := X)

end
end Hartshorne
